name: Tenshi no Nichou Kenjuu -Angelos Armas-
source:
When people die with hearts filled with negative feelings, they turn into 'ghosts', haunting the world. To send those souls to the other world, angels exist, using their guns to 'kill' them. You're playing one of such angels, Wim.

[Edited from [url=http://forums.megatokyo.com/index.php?showtopic=1698790]OLF[/url]]
translation:
人怀着负面情绪死去后，会化为“幽灵”徘徊于世。为了把这些灵魂送往另一个世界，天使们会用枪将它们“杀死”。玩家扮演的温便是这样一名天使。

[编辑自[url=http://forums.megatokyo.com/index.php?showtopic=1698790]OLF[/url]]
